column1: # One packet per line, read by all three parser implementations so they cannot silently
# disagree about what a valid packet is:
# A ground station that accepts a packet the transmitter would never send, or rejects one
# it does send, miscounts packet loss — the number an operator uses to judge the link.
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. The packet may be empty.
# Whitespace inside the packet is significant; do not reformat this file.
